scope: E2E v6 one-shot WS terminal wake and launcher/media identity; read only
findings: Per-request consumed flag remains true after the first event wake; subsequent iterations use the original sleep, so permanently set done does not create a busy loop.
Unconsumed timed waits remain cancellable by the original exception path. History, not the done event, still establishes actual completion.
Successful joined frozen observer breaks immediately after matching terminal event; collector.last_ns is that receive timestamp. Missing or invalid terminal remains null.
Terminal-to-artifact difference is signed arrival-order evidence; a negative value must not be reported as negative execution overhead or speed gain.
Launcher binds v6 controller and unchanged four-POST mode; actual InferRSI local executor supplies INFERRSI_RESULT_PATH.
Media launcher binds v6 driver SHA and validates both case-isolated actual requests 2 and 4 through unchanged native media validator.
Model, observer source, async two streams, no-pin, headroom, resource guards and cleanup remain the reviewed baseline.
